headline: Staging truth became independently rejectable from source tree to publicly served receipt.

items.title: Typed diagnostic discovery
items.insight: Agent discovery now validates what a diagnostic proves before advertising it. Partial, stale-plan, mutated, or malformed evidence becomes an explicit omission instead of inheriting trust from a filename.

items.title: Atomic staging deploy attestation
items.insight: A staging deploy now leaves a durable receipt that binds source, candidate, archive, rollback, parity, and remote file counts. The receipt is installed atomically and compared back from the origin before it can claim verification.
items.evidence: canonical staging receipt + SHA-256 archive verification

items.title: Protocol propagation truth dossier
items.insight: The local protocol was missing two canonical command sections while the propagation check stayed green. A signed four-test dossier now gives the canonical owner a reproducible repair target without touching a sibling tree.

items.title: Exact acknowledgement parser
items.insight: The first real deploy exposed an escaped-regex defect after staging had already reached exact parity. The parser is now a pure exact-one contract that accepts bounded noise and CRLF while rejecting duplicates and zero counts.

items.title: Hash-chained deploy chronology
items.insight: Latest-only truth became append-only history. Content-addressed rows bind unique deploys to their predecessor receipt, and the current receipt must be the validated chain head.

items.title: Served receipt revalidation
items.insight: Origin acknowledgement no longer stands in for what the public route serves later. A bounded one-shot HTTPS check validates the schema and requires exact byte equality with the local attestation.

items.title: Release-proof lineage binding
items.insight: Release proof now exposes deploy depth, head, and predecessor instead of presenting one receipt without history. Missing, detached, or replayed chronology is an explicit hold.

items.title: Acyclic receipt/discovery graph
items.insight: Final fixed-point proof exposed a cryptographic cycle: discovery advertised the receipt while the receipt fingerprinted discovery. Generated discovery remains blocking-contract checked and candidate-Merkle-bound, but no longer invalidates the receipt it consumes.

followUps: Independently compare the served NDJSON history itself without introducing a manifest cycle.
Verify the canonical protocol propagation repair after the signed Ark response.
blockers: Production promotion remains held on genuine identity, provider, control-plane, and recovery evidence.
Production Worker routes remain mismatched and RUM evidence remains unavailable; neither was backfilled.

honestyLedger.title: No production promotion
honestyLedger.why: Green staging does not grant auth/security authority or replace real-provider evidence.

honestyLedger.title: First deploy parser red preserved
honestyLedger.why: Staging parity was real, but no receipt was claimed until the acknowledgement contract was repaired and redeployed.

honestyLedger.title: Six bad audit premises declined
honestyLedger.why: Refresh-only, fabricated-summary, gamified-incident, founder-voice, and authority-gated work were recorded rather than silently skipped.

amortization.verdict: protocol meter under-counted a completed saturated arc because listRemaining is null
